integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the Fourier product identity, a blockwise AM--GM optimization under box and sum constraints, and complement symmetry. Exact-rational enumeration is used only as a replay check.
scientific_limitations: The parity identity is classical; originality is claimed only for the exact fixed-mean envelope and its extremizer structure.
The literature search was targeted and an equivalent optimization could exist under different terminology.
The theorem assumes mutual independence and only a first-moment constraint.
title: Sharp parity envelope for fixed-mean Poisson-binomial sums
